samurai_oyoroi.png:
Qiuqiu, a chibi grey tabby cat: light grey fur with darker grey stripes, a WHITE face, white chest and white paws, pink inner ears, big round dark eyes with glossy white highlights, small pink blush strokes on both cheeks, a NAVY BLUE headband tied round the head with two long trailing tails. Head about as big as the whole body, short stubby limbs, no neck - exactly the same cat as in the reference image.

Now dress him as a SAMURAI in full ceremonial O-YOROI armour: big square shoulder guards (o-sode), deep red lacquered scale plates laced with cords over the chest and thighs, a horned kabuto helmet with a golden crescent crest pushed back so the navy headband still shows underneath, a small back banner. Heavy, grand, ornate.
 Full body, three-quarter view facing RIGHT, standing in a calm ready stance, feet at the bottom of the frame. Nothing else in the picture: no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no border. There is exactly ONE character in the picture.
Style: thick black outlines, FLAT colours with only subtle soft shading - not painterly, not a rendered illustration look. Cute cartoon, not photorealistic. Background must be plain solid WHITE.
If any enemy appears, it is a small grey rat or a small orange tabby bandit cat - NEVER another copy of the hero and never anything that looks like him. Enemies stay small and near the edges so the hero is clearly the main subject filling the centre.

Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as samurai_oyoroi.png in the current directory and report the path.
